8:70.text: Say to the captives that are in your hands! "If Allâh knows any good in your hearts, He will give you something better than what has been taken from you, and He will forgive you, and Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

8:71.text: But if they intend to betray you
, they indeed betrayed Allâh before. So He gave
power over them. And Allâh is All-Knower, All-Wise.

8:72.text: Verily, those who believed, and emigrated and strove hard and fought with their property and their lives in the Cause of Allâh as well as those who gave
allies to one another. And as to those who believed but did not emigrate
(to you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, you owe no duty of protection to them until they emigrate
; but if they seek your help in religion, it is your duty to help them except against a people with whom you have a treaty of mutual alliance; and Allâh is the All-Seer of what you do.

8:73.text: And those who disbelieve are allies of one another,
[i.e. become allies, as one united block under one Khalifah (a chief Muslim ruler for the whole Muslim world) to make victorious Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism]
and oppression on the earth, and a great mischief and corruption

8:74.text: And those who believed, and emigrated and strove hard in the Cause of Allâh
, as well as those who gave
asylum and aid - these are the believers in truth, for them is forgiveness and Rizqun Karîm

8:75.text: And those who believed afterwards, and emigrated and strove hard along with you
, they are of you. But kindred by blood are nearer to one another
in the decree ordained by Allâh. Verily, Allâh is the All-Knower of everything.
